_doc: Shared pay-period status contract (UC-003 guide §5.1) — the ONE place
JSON so Node, Jest and Vite all load the same file with zero tooling.
Lifecycle: draft → validated → calculated → pending_approval → approved → paid.
UC-003 owns exactly two transitions: validated→calculated (a run completes)
and calculated→pending_approval (manager submits). UC-003 must never write
'approved' or 'paid'. Once a period is in a status listed in uc003Locked,
UC-003 data (adjustments, performance inputs) is locked and recalculation
